notes.title: Dev Update: We're almost done
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there! [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/cc5e168decceddb88530a0224970ba5a34b2cb23.gif[/img]
Ahhhhh, that's my meme quota reached!

We're getting close to wrapping up building the game and entering the next phase: bug fixes. But! Before we get there, we wanted to give you a little update on how it's going. So let's get started!

[h1]We're working on a new trailer![/h1]

You might have noticed that the Unbound trailer on the steam page is a bit dated. There's no shame in admitting that, it was made a long time ago when our skills weren't as sharp and our team wasn't as big. As such, it's now getting the remake treatment. However we're being REALLY picky this time since the trailer is literally the first thing you see when you come on our steam page, so we want to give you a feast!

That being said, here's a cheeky sneaky peaky:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/6bdb2ab98e6e8e3950cd84cf5f63d61a0fe7bfad.gif[/img]

[h1]So how is dev going?[/h1]

Like I said we're in the final stages but what does that mean? Well, if you follow the Steam news closely you'll know that level design is done! 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/814680/view/3058478454614068413
The main mechanics and done, the platforming feels good, the animations... are not quite there yet, we still need to properly animate a few more monsters since they kind of behave weird right now, and we might need to make a tweak or two to the map screen so it properly resembles the level.

Disclaimer: Not 100% sure of the map thing, maybe Sergiu just gave me an old build to troll me. Wouldn't surprise me...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/40b0f0da10323c39089deee555f6465ed6a232e9.png[/img]

[h1]Have your say![/h1]

Sooo we've started a thing on discord, and it might catch your fancy. There is now a polls channel and every week we make a new poll that helps us figure out which direction to take the game in. Sometimes it's very impactful:

"Do you want to have your character aesthetic change as you unlock secrets in the game?"

Sometimes it's not as impactful:

"Does this cutscene look better normal or mirrored?"

And sometimes it's downright stupid:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/d199e6ff96a488d5e444f10e9cfb47121cd0ec10.png[/img]

So join the Unbound discord server to take part in the fun!

Conclusion

We are on the right track, and that's a really good thing to say considering the crazy amount of moving targets we've had during this game's development: Pandemic, cancelled gaming events, taking on new team members, growing expectations, all of that. 

It feels good to be on schedule, it feels good to be in control, ONWARD!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/b122aaf9268829031036e3dc656a1135fe12e3f3.gif[/img]

notes.title: Unbound New Updates. Level Design Complete!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/1ed31d142d2f0505005c2ce19306bf68dd136035.png[/img]

Hello everyone, 

Hope you are all really well! We have new exciting announcements and updates on Unbound: Worlds Apart!  

[h1]Game level design complete[/h1]

This means a couple of things:

[list]
[*] The game level flow is ready.  So the game is finally playable from start to finish.
[*] Quests and characters complete.  That means the story and the lore are ready along with all the dialogues, all characters designs and animations as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/19cbff33d301672e539da18218eb8297b0e48f8c.gif[/img]
[*] All the portals are ready.  We don't want to spoil how many portals there are in the game, but we did our best to make each portal interesting and special.
[*] All the game mechanics are set in place.  Portals + Soli's abilities  =  Love.  Combine them and there are lots of interesting puzzles to solve and challenging platforming sections.
[*] Secrets. Well, secrets are secrets waiting to be discovered.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/a8a4b03c34baa4c5f6b5e9454a39597ac184ef3f.png[/img]

There is still some work to be done on the final boss because we want to make sure it is challenging, engaging and terrifying at the same time.

[h1]Environment Art Update[/h1]

Creating assets for 2 worlds, placing them in the engine and making sure the game feels right and looks amazing is very time-consuming.  We welcome Gézu Molnár (one of the creators of WarriOrb) into our art team.  He is going to help create some awesome environments and VFXs for Unbound. Here are some scenes created by Gézu:

Spooky:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/484051dc3d7c0de292ccc5e1061f464b3992826e.png[/img]

The desert:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/9259e3f81c6296cd7413827d5c28bb609fe1ddc4.png[/img]

And the portal:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/b734a1ffccaef1fc1d50ebfa0e930a769e58560a.png[/img]

With Olga, Alex, Mircea and Gezu working full time on the game, we will have all the art in place in time for our still unannounced launch.

[h1]Music and SFX Update[/h1]

We are super happy to announce that we are working with Alexey Nechaev and Igor Chernyshev on music and SFX for Unbound. They both worked on awesome games like Inmost ("Best Audio Design" - LT Game Awards), Time Loader, [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MZVQxof_aFM&ab_channel=tinyBuildGAMES]Punch Club 2[/url] etc. With ultra detail sounds and almost one hour of magical soundtrack, the world of Unbound is becoming even more alive!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/938560/INMOST/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301950/Time_Loader/

[h1]Cutscenes [/h1]

For cutscenes we decided to do them in a traditional 2D fashion and David Chambolee with his team is helping us achieve that. We are really happy with the progress and we'll have a sneak peek in the upcoming updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/b122aaf9268829031036e3dc656a1135fe12e3f3.gif[/img]

[h1]Community Manager[/h1]

[url=https://twitter.com/taranasus]Justin Popa (Taranasus)[/url] is a guru when it comes to wide-reach social media (like Facebook, Twitter, Reddit and Imgur) and will help us get the word out of the game before launch, as well as entertain you in our [url=http://discord.gg/unbound]discord server[/url]. He likes making memes out of anything so... be prepared for that, as well as leaking various bits in chat without our permission. So if you want to see more behind-the-scenes stuff, join on our discord server, he's usually around talking about interesting things :).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/30db3130a7eb4aa739f875e4f5f6822721e4a221.png[/img]
Taranasus is behind the mountains, but you cannot see him

[i]Taranasus's note: If you understand the joke above, can you leave a comment explaining it to me please? I am still confused and Sergiu refuses to explain it to me[/i]

In the next update we hope to show you our new trailer with updated graphics, abilities and new portals.

Stay tuned,
APS team!

notes.title: Unbound Winter Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Hope you are all really well! We have been very busy working on Unbound but we think we can share some new stuff that we been working on.

In the demo, we had a few characters that give you about the quests. But lots of you said you want more characters as well for the lore.  So we added new characters for the full game, this one is the Record Keeper. We have more, can't wait to show more in the future!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/b368b8b476f70bffad611d0520090eadd9e45d0a.gif[/img]

We integrated new art in the game. Here are some interesting concept arts:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/636f91d583693b112db62b4ea5b4327a2da1ff57.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/22faa23800c8cecca9d1ed461e5876f2a57104f0.jpg[/img]

Finally, we are working on the cutscenes are well. This cutscene image could be a  wallpaper:

notes.title: One Year since our Kickstarter Campaign
notes.content:
[h1]Future of Unbound: Worlds Apart
[/h1]
The game evolved a lot during this time. From just a simple puzzle game to a puzzle platformer with Metroidvania elements. Soli can get new abilities like double jump or dash and he also has to face some bosses in his journey. Besides abilities and bosses, we also added some secret maps with harder platforming sections and more difficult puzzles for completionists.

Right now Unbound has around 5 hours of gameplay on the main path (main quests) but we still need to add more art and polish the visuals of the levels.  We also have to develop one more map which will add at least one hour of gameplay on the main path.

We still have a lot of work to do to make Unbound the best game it can be. That's why we decided to postpone the launch to [b]Q1 of 2021.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/ffa47d29a515817d3549f62580b36d74707bbe81.jpg[/img]

[h1]Live AMA (ask me anything) on Twitch and Steam.[/h1]

Thursday (tomorrow) at 18:00 PM GMT we are going to be live on Twitch and Steam. Join us to chat more about development progress on Unbound.

Twitch: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/alienpixel ]https://www.twitch.tv/alienpixel [/url]
Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1234810/Unbound_Worlds_Apart_Prologue/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1234810/Unbound_Worlds_Apart_Prologue/[/url]

[h1]The Unbound Prologue
[/h1]
We decided to launch the Unbound: Worlds Apart Prologue as a stand-alone game because the maps and the story will undergo lots of changes in the full game.

It's been one month since we launched the prologue for Unbound and it was very well received and played by over 85k people. We are also very happy to brag about receiving an overwhelmingly positive score review. YEY!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207117/e39094d1307aaef7564f0766ea787b446c97606a.jpg[/img]

You can play the prologue [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1234810/Unbound_Worlds_Apart_Prologue/]here[/url]. 

Also if you like it please don't forget to write a review and share it with your friends :)
